evidence: We have begun leveraging artificial intelligence for certain of our operations.

Failure to invest adequately in artificial intelligence may result in us lagging behind our competitors in terms of improving operational efficiency and achieving superior outcomes for our business and our residents.
recent developments in artificial intelligence, including software used to price rent in apartment communities

We may encounter challenges such as a shortage of appropriate data to train internal artificial intelligence models, a lack of skilled talent to effectively execute our strategy of leveraging artificial intelligence internally
ai_positioning.summary: CSR utilise l'IA en interne pour optimiser ses opérations immobilières (notamment la tarification des loyers) mais adopte une approche prudente, consciente des risques de cybersécurité, de manque de données et de talents nécessaires pour une implémentation réussie.
